privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: How AMANIQ Academy collects, uses and protects personal data.
privacy.body:
## Who we are

AMANIQ Academy is a business division of AMANIQ Projects Limited ("we", "us"). AMANIQ Projects Limited is the data controller for personal data processed through academy.amaniqgroup.com. [Placeholder: registered address and RC number.]

## What we collect

- **Account data**: your name, email address and password (passwords are handled by our authentication provider and stored only as secure hashes).
- **Learning records**: enrolments, lesson progress, lab submissions, examination attempts and results, badges and certificates.
- **Payment records**: order and payment status and references from our payment provider. We never receive or store full card details.
- **Enquiries**: what you send us through contact forms.
- **Technical data**: security logs needed to protect the service, such as sign-in attempts used for rate limiting (stored as one-way hashes).

## Why we use it

To provide and secure the service, deliver courses and assessments, issue and verify certificates, process payments, respond to enquiries and meet legal obligations. [Placeholder: confirm lawful bases with counsel, e.g. contract, legitimate interests, legal obligation, consent.]

## Certificate verification

When you earn a certificate, a public verification page shows your name as it appears on the certificate, the programme, issue date, certificate number and status. It does not show your email address or any other account information.

## Sharing

We share data only with service providers who help us run the platform (hosting, database, authentication, payment processing), under appropriate agreements, or where the law requires it. [Placeholder: list processors and hosting regions.]

## Retention

[Placeholder: retention periods for accounts, learning records, payment records and enquiries.] Certificate records are kept so that verification remains possible.

## Your rights

Subject to applicable law, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, you may request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal data, object to certain processing, and complain to the Nigeria Data Protection Commission. Contact us at [Placeholder: privacy contact email].

## Analytics

We do not use third-party advertising trackers. [Placeholder: describe any privacy-preserving analytics if introduced.]

## Changes

We will post updates on this page with a new effective date. Effective date: [Placeholder].

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.summary: The terms that apply when you use AMANIQ Academy.
terms.body:
## Agreement

By creating an account or enrolling you agree to these terms, the acceptable-use policy for labs and the refund and cancellation policy. The service is provided by AMANIQ Projects Limited through its AMANIQ Academy division.

## Accounts

Provide accurate information, keep your password secure and do not share your account. Your name as entered is used on certificates. You must not attempt to obtain administrative access or alter assessment or certificate records.

## Courses and access

Enrolment gives you personal, non-transferable access to the purchased programme version for [Placeholder: access duration]. Course content may be updated; your completion records are tied to the version you enrolled in.

## Assessments and certificates

Examinations must be completed by you, without assistance from others. We may investigate suspected misconduct and revoke certificates obtained improperly. AMANIQ certificates confirm completion of an AMANIQ programme; they are not government-accredited qualifications or vendor certifications.

## Payments

Prices are shown in Nigerian Naira unless stated otherwise and are charged through our payment provider. Access is granted only after the payment provider confirms the payment.

## Intellectual property

Course materials are owned by AMANIQ Projects Limited or its licensors. You may use them for your personal learning only. Third-party resources linked from lessons remain subject to their owners' terms.

acceptable-use.title: Acceptable-use policy for cybersecurity labs
acceptable-use.summary: Rules for practical security exercises inside and outside the AMANIQ platform.
acceptable-use.body:
## Purpose

AMANIQ Academy teaches practical security skills. Those skills must only be used lawfully and ethically. This policy applies to every learner, instructor and administrator.

## Inside the platform

- All AMANIQ labs are **simulations** built on synthetic data. They do not connect to real systems.
- Do not attempt to attack, probe or disrupt the AMANIQ platform itself, other learners' accounts or our infrastructure. Report suspected vulnerabilities responsibly to [Placeholder: security contact].
- Do not share lab answers, examination questions or other learners' work.

## Outside the platform

- Never test, scan or access any system, network, application or cloud account unless you own it or have **explicit written authorisation** from its owner that defines the scope.
- Use only intentionally vulnerable practice environments that you run in an isolated network, or reputable training platforms used under their terms.
- Unauthorised access to computer systems is a criminal offence in Nigeria and most other countries.

## Consequences

Breaching this policy may lead to suspension of your account, revocation of certificates and, where appropriate, referral to the relevant authorities.

## Questions

If you are unsure whether an activity is permitted, do not do it. Ask us first at [Placeholder: contact email].

refunds.title: Refund and cancellation policy
refunds.summary: When refunds are available and how to request one.
refunds.body:
> **Configurable policy.** This page is a template. AMANIQ Projects Limited must confirm the actual refund window and conditions before launch.

## Refund window

You may request a full refund within **[Placeholder: number] days** of purchase if you have completed no more than **[Placeholder: e.g. 20%]** of the required lessons and have not attempted the final examination.

## How to request a refund

Contact us at [Placeholder: contact email] with your order reference (shown in your payment history). We will confirm eligibility and process approved refunds through the original payment method. Processing times depend on the payment provider and your bank.

## Effect of a refund

When a refund is processed, access to the programme is removed. Certificates are not issued for refunded enrolments.

## Cancellations by AMANIQ Academy

If we withdraw a programme you have paid for before you can complete it, we will offer a full refund or a transfer to another programme.

## Corporate purchases

Refunds for corporate training arrangements are governed by the relevant agreement.

Effective date: [Placeholder].
